question.title: Market question
question.description: The question the market resolves on.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Polymarket event slug, used to build the market URL.

condition_id.title: Condition ID
condition_id.description: On-chain condition identifier of the market.

daily_reward_usd.title: Daily reward (USD)
daily_reward_usd.description: Total reward pool paid out per day to makers who qualify.

rewards_min_size.title: Minimum order size
rewards_min_size.description: Minimum order size in shares required to qualify for rewards.

rewards_max_spread_cents.title: Max spread (cents)
rewards_max_spread_cents.description: Maximum distance from the midpoint, in cents, at which a quote still earns rewards.

liquidity_usd.title: Liquidity (USD)
liquidity_usd.description: Current liquidity in the market, in US dollars.

volume_24h_usd.title: 24h volume (USD)
volume_24h_usd.description: Trading volume over the last 24 hours.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the market stops trading, or null when the market has no scheduled end date.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Possible outcomes of the market, in the same order as outcome_prices.

outcome_prices.title: Outcome prices
outcome_prices.description: Current probability price of each outcome, 0 to 1, aligned with outcomes.

url.title: Market URL
url.description: Direct link to the market on Polymarket.

overview.title: Rewarded markets
overview.description: Polymarket markets paying daily liquidity-provider rewards, by payout size.
